Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Rabbits

Rabbits provided food and fur used in footwear, head coverings, and bags. Their presence also drew attention to surrounding vegetation. The entry connects animal knowledge with clothing, meals, and the plants of a place.1

Places named in the catalogue

Shinnecock territories; Long Island.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 10. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
